description: In support of communities experiencing hunger during the coronavirus (COVID-19) pandemic, Brooklyn Democratic Congresswoman Yvette D. Clarke (NY-09) and FreshDirect Foods Wednesday morning distributed 500 boxes of non-perishable foods and produce to local churches and nonprofit organizations in the Flatbush neighborhood. Read more here.

title: Clarke for Congress Clarke, FreshDirect deliver 500 boxes of food to Brooklynites
